automatic_failover_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable automatic failover for this account.
automatic_failover_enabled.title: Automatic failover enabled

capabilities.description: (Optional) A list of capabilities to enable, e.g. EnableServerless, EnableMongo.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

consistency_level.description: (Optional) The consistency level: BoundedStaleness, Eventual, Session, Strong or ConsistentPrefix.
consistency_level.title: Consistency level

free_tier_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable the Free Tier pricing option for this account.
free_tier_enabled.title: Free tier enabled

geo_locations.description: (Optional) The geographic locations the data is replicated to. When empty, the resource group location is used as the primary (failover_priority 0).
geo_locations.title: Geo locations

identity_ids.description: (Optional) A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs. Used when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: (Optional) The type of Managed Identity: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned or 'SystemAssigned, UserAssigned'. Leave null for no identity.
identity_type.title: Identity type

ip_range_filter.description: (Optional) A list of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to access the account.
ip_range_filter.title: Ip range filter

kind.description: (Optional) The kind of account: GlobalDocumentDB or MongoDB.
kind.title: Kind

local_authentication_disabled.description: (Optional) Disable local (key based) authentication and only allow Microsoft Entra authentication.
local_authentication_disabled.title: Local authentication disabled

max_interval_in_seconds.description: (Optional) Max lag time in seconds (BoundedStaleness only).
max_interval_in_seconds.title: Max interval in seconds

name.description: (Required) The name of the Cosmos DB account (globally unique). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

offer_type.description: (Optional) The Offer Type to use for this CosmosDB Account. Currently only Standard.
offer_type.title: Offer type

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed for this account.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

virtual_network_subnet_ids.description: (Optional) A list of subnet IDs allowed to access the account (service endpoints).
virtual_network_subnet_ids.title: Virtual network subnet ids
